# TKVK — Taj Kaushal Vikas Kendra

> Skill training, trade testing, document and PoE guidance, and Gulf placement support
> for Indian workers. Based in New Friends Colony, New Delhi.

Government of India recruitment licence: B-3252/DEL/PER/1000+/5/11251/2025
Operates under the same licence as Taj HR Services, which handles the employer side.

## Scope

Gulf countries only — Saudi Arabia, United Arab Emirates, Oman, Qatar, Kuwait, Bahrain.
No Europe, Canada, Malaysia or other destinations.

## What TKVK does

- Hands-on skill training in the worker's own trade
- Practice trade tests run the way a Gulf employer runs them
- Documents: passport and ECR status, GAMCA/Wafid medical, police clearance,
  certificate attestation, eMigrate PoE clearance
- Pre-departure briefing on contract terms and worker rights
- Placement through Taj HR Services' employer mandates

## Trades

Welder, electrician, pipe fitter, steel fixer, mason, scaffolder, HVAC technician,
heavy equipment operator, driver (light and heavy), hospitality staff, warehouse staff,
security guard, cleaning and facility staff, delivery rider, retail staff.
